authority.reason: All outcomes through 2025-07-31 were visible before this canonical ledger was assembled. The original generation protocols were hash-frozen before their respective metrics, but none is a sealed future holdout.

objective.display_policy: Always rank and display two rows on each source-complete scheduled session when at least two masked candidates exist.

common_training.sample_weight: Each training date sums to one in the Ridge loss only. SimpleImputer medians and StandardScaler moments are fitted with equal row weight by the registered scikit-learn Pipeline; this replay preserves that historical evaluation specification and does not claim weighted preprocessing.

H01_cross_sectional_state.mechanism: Daily cross-sectional percentile state for raw G0 history.

H03_downside_asymmetry.mechanism: Prior downside semideviation and large-loss versus large-gain frequency.

H04_horizon_transition.mechanism: Acceleration or decay across 1, 5, 20 and 60-session horizons.

H05_market_regime_switch.mechanism: Stock state interacted with strictly prior market breadth, tails, dispersion and volatility.

H06_calendar_stock_interaction.mechanism: Known-before-open weekday/month-end interactions and shrunk same-weekday alpha.

H07_tradability_quality.mechanism: Continuous reliability modifier from lagged no-trade, flat-session and zero-range propensity.

H08_lot_price_state.mechanism: Strictly prior share price as lot-affordability and microstructure proxy, never market capitalisation.

H09_range_exhaustion.mechanism: Continuation versus exhaustion from lagged shock, close location and range expansion.

H10_gap_response_state.mechanism: Most recent historical gap conditioned on each stock's prior gap response traits.

H11_cross_sectional_crowding.mechanism: Daily momentum/volatility crowding interacted with stock state.

H12_history_source_quality.mechanism: Explicit prior-history, missing-state and source-age uncertainty.

universe_groups.U04_mature_history: at least 180 strictly prior observed open-to-close returns
universe_groups.U05_tail_clean: prior rolling 60-session frequency of return <= -2 percent is <= 0.05

generation_1.use: Initial feature and universe screen; all registered candidates were subsequently reported in both confirmation periods.

generation_2.target: within-training-day average return percentile mapped to [-1,1]
generation_2.feature_test: Refit G0 plus one registered group.
generation_2.universe_test: Keep the common fitted G0 model and restrict only the pre-ranking scoring candidate set.

generation_3.why_only_h07: It was the sole alpha-10 candidate with positive uplift in all three periods and all whole-period shadow robustness checks.
generation_3.combination: No combination was registered because no second group met those transport criteria.

all_required: top2 net20 uplift versus G0 strictly positive
positive monthly uplift fraction at least 0.5
shared-family maximum-statistic five-session block-bootstrap one-sided 80 percent lower bound nonnegative
at least 9 of 13 monthly net20 means positive
at least 3 of 4 fixed blocks net20 positive
uplift versus the generation anchor strictly positive in discovery, confirmation A and confirmation B
H07 uplift versus alpha-1 G0 strictly positive in every one of the three chronological periods
overall paired five-session bootstrap one-sided 80 percent uplift lower bound nonnegative
all whole-period shadow checks excluding the already stated period-uplift condition

limitations: The historical JPX archive used here does not supply usable volume, turnover, spread or exact one-lot execution cost.
Strictly prior share price is only a lot-value proxy and cannot represent market capitalisation.
No exact historical 08:58 indicative gap, futures, order imbalance or PTS snapshot is available.
Multiple testing is controlled for the registered discovery families, but all dates remain known-outcome retrospective research.
